dedupe_keys.name: percent cropland coverage map for sub saharan africa cropland synergy map fritz and others 2011

description: This dataset is a map of the percentage of each pixel covered by cropland in Africa, made by combining five land cover products: GLC-2000, MODIS Land Cover, GlobCover, MODIS Crop Likelihood and AfriCover. The PANGAEA record says a synergy map ranked the products by expert judgement to give the likelihood that each pixel is cropland, and the result was calibrated with national and sub-national crop statistics; a preliminary validation gave 83 percent accuracy, higher than any single input map. It was published in 2011 by Steffen Fritz, Liangzhi You, Andriy Bun, Linda See, Ian McCallum and co-authors as a downloadable ZIP of about 2.3 MB, free under CC BY 3.0, with coverage of sub-Saharan Africa. Caveats: it reflects land cover products from the 2000s, the pixel size is not stated on the page read, and the accuracy figure is from a preliminary validation. For simulation it gives the share of cropland per cell to place agricultural exposure in drought, flood and heat scenarios, and to weight food production losses when irrigation, roads or markets fail. Related catalogue records include the Unified Cropland Layer and the CLIMADA crop production exposure data for humanitarian response countries.
